update.title: Version update
update.hint.browser: A page served to a browser cannot update itself: version updates only work in the desktop app. That is a permission boundary, not a bug - a web page must not be able to replace local program files.
update.current.builtin: Built into the installer (update channel not enabled yet)
update.source.label: Update source
update.source.hint: A local folder (USB stick, network share) or an intranet address. The app ships with no update address of its own: only what you type here is used.
update.action.rollback: Roll back to the previous version
update.state.installed: {value} installed; it takes effect after a restart
update.progress.busy: Downloading and verifying. No percentage is shown: the service publishes no progress, and a made-up number would be a lie.
update.reason.source_not_configured: No update source configured yet - fill in a folder or address above
update.reason.timeout: Timed out contacting the update source ({value})
update.reason.http_status: The update source returned an error status ({value})
update.reason.bad_index: The index.json at the update source is malformed ({value})
update.reason.host_missing_capability: This package needs a newer TraceLens build ({value})
update.reason.host_too_old: This TraceLens version is too old for that package ({value})
update.reason.hash_mismatch: A file inside the package did not match its digest; installation refused ({value})
update.reason.missing_entries: The package is incomplete; installation refused ({value})
update.reason.undeclared_entries: The package contains undeclared files; installation refused ({value})
update.reason.unsafe_path: The package contains an unsafe path; installation refused ({value})
update.reason.no_previous_version: There is no previous version to roll back to
update.reason.no_target: There is no version to roll back to
update.reason.status_failed: Could not read local version information ({value})
